messages:
Mira L.: Heads-up: final prep for the review cycle upload. Manager edits are due Wed 2025-02-12 17:00 UTC. Were doing the bulk Workday ingest Thu 2025-02-13 08:00 UTC. Post any edgecases here.

Owen K.: Quick form note: use "Manager Review Form v6" (fields renamed to competency_id). Link: https://go/redwood/mgr-v6. Please don't mix versions.

Gina R.: How should managers tag performance improvement plans (PIPs)?

Mira L.: Tag PIPs in the header: PIP=true and include start_date and owner. Those records will be kept for calibration but highlighted.

Sam T.: Contractors/temps: same form but add header contractor=true and end_date. We will not include them in calibration by default.

Owen K.: If you need to anonymize peer feedback for cross-org panels, add ANON_REQUEST=true in header and upload the anonymized artifact to the secure folder.

Gina R.: Can new managers get a form walkthrough? I have 3 first-time managers.

Mira L.: Yep  20m prep slots Tue 2025-02-11 09:00 & 15:00 UTC. Sign-up: https://go/redwood/review-prep.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Wed 2025-02-12 17:00 UTC" posted 2025-02-09 08:00 UTC. Reaction: :alarm_clock:

Sam T.: Calibration panels: Thu 2025-02-13 13:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (75m). If you have >8 directs DM people-ops for a private panel.

Owen K.: Import tip: reviewer name must match directory (case-sensitive). If ingest fails, capture the error screenshot and csv slice and DM me. I can run a targeted re-import.

Mira L.: Exception rules: late edits accepted only for LOA, termination, or payroll corrections. Tag with EXCEPTION_REASON and specify urgency. Non-urgent late changes are queued for next cycle.

Gina R.: Sample copy managers can paste: "Reminder: Manager edits due Wed 17:00 UTC. Use Manager Review Form v6. Attach evidence for any <=2 ratings and tag PIP/LOA in header. Ingest Thu 08:00 UTC. DM #people-ops for a handoff slot"

Owen K.: If anyone wants the small mapping script for our new competency IDs I can share it in DM. Keep exports under 10MB for the ingest window.

Mira L.: Ill post the final pre-ingest checklist Tue morning and close signups 2 hours before each panel. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
